name: Geometry Shader Advanced Instancing for Cubes
definition: A technique using geometry shaders to generate cube meshes from instanced points. It optimizes for visibility by emitting at most 12 vertices (3 quads) per cube, leveraging backface culling and frustum culling in projection space.
summary: Geometry Shader Advanced Instancing for Cubes optimizes volume rendering by emitting only visible cube faces, reducing vertex count from 24 to 12 per voxel.
